column2: Space. The Earth turns slowly below, seen from orbit, as white text appears beside it.
The universe has a beginning, but it has no end. Infinite.
Stars too have a beginning, but are by their own power destroyed. Finite.
The Earth darkens into night. History teaches that those who hold wisdom are often the most foolish.
The fish in the sea know nothing of the land.
If they too hold wisdom, they too will be destroyed. Music Composers: Takeshi Abo, Toshimichi Isoe.
It is more ridiculous for man to exceed light speed than for fish to live ashore. Producer: Tatsuya Matsubara.
This may also be called God's final warning to those who rebel.
5pb. x Nitroplus presents. The sun rises from behind the Earth in a burst of light.
